title.text: Material QEMU · Lang gui Expressive remake

n1.text: Dashboard. Host gauges sweep in, running machines show live console thumbnails and per-guest CPU, the floating New machine button sits on the rail. Try the Tweaks: seed colour, light or dark, motion. Not built yet in the app: live thumbnails, guest CPU.

n2.text: Machines. Filter chips, grid or list, state badges and one-tap power. Click a card's power button to see the state animate. Bulk actions and saved views carry over from the current app.

n3.text: New machine with every common QEMU option grouped into sections: system and firmware (BIOS, UEFI, Secure Boot, TPM), CPU topology, memory, disks with bus and format, CD, NICs with port forwards, display, sound, USB, serial, boot order. The live command preview on the right is generated by the server. Click the sections.

n4.text: Machine. Console with a toolbar (Ctrl+Alt+Del, screenshot, CD swap, fullscreen), power controls (start, pause, reset, ACPI shutdown, power off), snapshot timeline with create, restore and delete, live CPU and memory, and the QEMU log.

n5.text: Storage. ISO library and disk images in one place: upload with progress, import VMDK, VDI, VHDX or raw and convert to qcow2, resize, clone. Every destructive action uses the two-key gate.

n6.text: Settings. Dynamic colour from a seed, light, dark or system, motion level, language, passkeys and password sign-in, and host facts (QEMU version, accelerators).

n8.text: Documentation site (GitHub Pages). Leads with tasks, not files: host in a VM, install on a PC, first machine, updating, the console. A search box with a regex builder beside it filters guides and articles. Guides are steppers over real screenshots and remember your place. Articles and wiki pages are complete on the site. Click Guides, and toggle Regex.

n9.text: Windows host app (installed with Squirrel). Runs the web app on this computer for the network, shows the address to open with Open and Copy, Start and Stop, QEMU status (offers to install it through Chocolatey when missing), the data folder and the log, and can start at sign-in. Toggle Start/Stop.

n7.text: First account. No setup code: the first account created becomes the owner, and later visitors sign in. Passkey sign-in sits beside password sign-in.
